$comment: Discount ceilings written on the price pages themselves.
'Max Discount 5%' against a part, in the discount column of the row that part
sits on. Unambiguous in a way most of the workbook comments are not, which is
why these 29 were the ones seeded active while the other 144 stayed drafts.
They were seeded straight into cpq.rule and never went through this generator,
so the service capped them and the preview did not. Both engines read a cap off
a rule action; generating them here puts the same ceiling in front of the rep
and on the order. See data/discount-caps.md.
